definitions: A classic emulsion sauce made with egg yolk, butter, and lemon juice or vinegar that has separated into an unappetizing, lumpy, or oily consistency.
Hollandaise sauce that has broken due to overheating, insufficient emulsification, or adding ingredients too quickly.
examples: The chef had to discard the curdled hollandaise sauce.
She tried to rescue the curdled hollandaise sauce, but it was beyond repair.
The brunch special was ruined by the curdled hollandaise sauce.
